publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In view of low radar signal sorting accuracy in electronic support measures system (ESM), a new sparsity-based radar signal sorting method is put forward in this paper. Firstly, the pulse description words (PDW) of radar pulse sequence are analyzed and normalized, and then represented as a sparse linear combination of the sparse representation dictionary. Secondly, the sparse solution is calculated by solving an optimization problem under L1 norm. Finally, the linear correlation coefficients between the sparse solutions of test sample and standard samples are calculated and compared to determine the classification of radar signal. The experiment result showed that the radar signal sorting accuracy of this method is 96%, and the performance of the method is superior to other radar signal sorting algorithms. So this sparsity-based radar signal sorting method has high accuracy and strong anti-noise interference ability.

articleTitle: Effects of temperature and Relative Humidity on microcalorimeter measurements
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, we present the measurement principle of the microcalorimeters which are served as primary national standards of microwave and millimeter power of China. Thermistor mounts are served as transfer standards which are calibrated in microcalorimeters. We exposed the effects of the temperature fluctuation on the measurement of microcalorimeters and we proposed a method with Average Temperature Blocks (ATBs) to eliminate the effects. In addition, we found that the level of Relative Humidity could affect the measurement results, although the cause of the influence was not ensured.

articleTitle: Research on self-calibration carbon monoxide sensor for iron mines
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In view of troubles like short calibration cycle, low intelligence, difficult maintenance, personnel operating error, etc. which exist in carbon monoxide sensor for iron mines, and on the basis of the principle of linear or near linear relationship between the output value of carbon monoxide sensitive element and the concentration of measured gas, method in which the calibration data are issued to each carbon monoxide sensor to carry out calibration according to time and location number via the upper computer, based on the data base being sorted out by the calibration data obtained by actual long-time calibration to the carbon monoxide sensor, is adopted, by combining with intelligent failure diagnosis circuit, a kind of self-calibration carbon monoxide sensor for iron mines is developed, which can carry out self-calibration to the element, and self-diagnosis for element damage, normal operation of power source, failures in short circuit, open circuit, communication signals of the circuit that integrating a variety of output standards. Through the field application test in Gongchangling underground iron mine, measurement error of the self-calibration carbon monoxide sensor for iron mines after automatic calibration can meet the actual requirement of iron mines; it can be more extensively popularized and applied.

articleTitle: Control strategy of three-point supported automatic levelling platform
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on three-point supported automatic leveling platform, this paper first establishes the mathematical model of leveling platform, and determines the kinematic relationship between front&rear pitching, left&right lifting and its supporting leg action, then tests and analyzes different leveling control methods on the platform through the experiment, finally explores the coordinated control strategy of signal acquisition system and platform support leg servo system and leveling control system according to the test data, and presents flow chart of the control strategy in the working process of the automatic leveling platform. The control strategy can guarantee the fast response of the automatic leveling platform during the leveling process.

articleTitle: Research on Yangzhou Goose breeding system based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The establishment of electronic file for modern poultry production and breeding represents the new trend in the industry. At the same time, every step of poultry production has significant effect on the safety of poultry products, and as a result, technical methods need to be taken to ensure safety management, identify who is responsible and protect the brand reputation. This paper uses Yangzhou Goose as an example in studying the establishment of a standardized goose breeding basic database, design of RFID-based smart foot ring that can collect various kinds of information, in an effort to develop a smart goose breeding system. This smart goose breeding system can track information during breeding and production, which can offer individual production information and guarantee the safety of goose products while traditional recording system merely records pedigree information.

articleTitle: Hands-on learning of measurement technologies using NI myDAQ and Vernier biomedical sensors
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper describes the development of the introductory measurement experiment for the learners who are studying biomedical measurement, using National Instruments myDAQ and Vernier biomedical sensors. The learners measure the surface temperature, grip strength and heart rate by using the Surface Temperature Sensor, Hand Dynamometer and Hand-Grip Heart Rate Monitor, respectively. The learners also create the simplest measurement program and make the suitable bar charts with error bars to present the results of the measurements. The contents and evaluation of the developed measurement experiment are presented.

articleTitle: Saliency aggregation via hard-voting evolution
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Generic object level saliency detection is important for many vision tasks, such as object detection, compression, recognition, segmentation and so on‥ A variety of saliency detection methods have been proposed in recently, which often complement each other. In order to combine them, we propose a Hard-voting Evolution saliency aggregation algorithm in this paper. Specially, it is consist of three stages. First, we integrate each individual map to get a reference map by linear summation. Second, each of the individual maps is updated in Bayes framework based on the obtained reference map. Third, we use our proposed approach to get the aggregated saliency map. Finally, we do iterative operation to further improve performance. Experiments on three publicly available datasets demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs favorably against the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A high precision CCD device quantum efficiency calibration device and the evaluation of uncertainty measurement
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Quantum efficiency is one of the most important parameters of CCD, according to the high precision of current CCD device quantum efficiency calibration requirements, provides a high accuracy CCD device quantum efficiency measurement method. The incident light source of the method using 632.8nm laser as the integral ball, produce monochromatic large area uniform light, as in the 632.8nm wavelength point standard detector is directly traceable to a cryogenic radiometer,through this design to reduce intermediate links, greatly improve the system measurement uncertainty, achieved the CCD device quantum efficiency is directly traceable to cryogenic radiometer, and expanded uncertainty of the system is evaluated and analyzed, the system is obtained by the expanded uncertainty was 1.5%. Finally, the choice of two CCD devices for the measurement uncertainty of the system is verified,it shows that the system can meet the calibration of high precision CCD device quantum efficiency, can provide more accurate data for the use of the CCD device manufacturers and users.

articleTitle: Series system of symmetrical six-phase PMSM two-motor supplied from single voltage source inverter
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The paper proposes a symmetrical six-phase PMSM two-motor drive system which consists of a six-phase PMSM series-connected with a three-phase PMSM driven by a single inverter. This enables full decoupling vector control of the two machines. Detailed mathematical modeling of the system is presented. A simulation model with vector control is constructed by Matlab/simulink. The simulation results show that the speed changing of one motor has no influences on the other motor, which validate the feasibility of independent control of the two machines.

articleTitle: PSO-PID based temperature control method for Bifilar Helix Calculable Resistor
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Bifilar Helix Calculable Resistor(BHCR) is a kind of calculable standard resistor developed as the standard component which can make the AC resistance quantity value indirectly traced to Quantum Hall Resistance(QHR). For the purpose of improving the resistance stability of BHCR, a PSO-PID based temperature control method for the especially designed resistance box is presented in this paper. The temperature control system based on MSP430F149 and high precision digital temperature sensor Tsic506 is developed. Results of the trial indicated that DC resistance relative stability of BHCR has been improved from 1.5 ppm to 0.35ppm.

articleTitle: Self-calibration and field experiments analysis of fiber-optic current sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: All-fiber current sensors designed in Faraday principle have been widely used for monitoring and protection of smart electric network, energy conservation and energy efficiency measurement etc.; these sensors have drawn widespread attentions and researches home and abroad. However, lack of research on sensor characteristics leads that sensors' reliabilities are sometimes difficult to meet harsh operating conditions of the industrial field. This paper introduces the structure and working principle of optical fiber current sensors in polarization reflected interferometric light-way structure. We have developed a set of optical fiber current sensors, and the influence of their linearity, the equal ampere-turn charecters and the influence of sensors' linearity, ampere-turns and current directions to sensors' performance has been verified in laboratory. We used the developed DC large current sensors to do site tests in the non-ferrous metal electrolytic plant. Sensors were installed at different locations of the current bus, and error of the test results is within ±0.2%. We also verified the sensor resistance to radio frequency (RF) electromagnetic radiation immunity. Experimental test data shows overall errors of optical fiber large current sensor systems can satisfy demands of site testing.

articleTitle: Indirect tire pressure monitoring system based on tire vertical stiffness
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the tire inflation pressure changes leading to tire vertical stiffness variation, formulas including tire inflation pressure, load, rolling radius and tire footprint width are deduced. And determine wheel speed sensor numerical value as the critical parameter of predicting tire pressure change. The tire pressure monitoring test is designed and carried out, and the correctness of the algorithm is verified by data analysis.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained reactive power planning of wind farm integrated distribution system considering voltage stability
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Because the intermittence and fluctuation of the wind turbine output, the integration of wind farm to distribution system brings great effect on voltage stability of grid. So the reactive power planning of wind farm distribution system should consider the impact of wind power on voltage stability. This paper addresses probabilistic model of wind turbine and uses point estimate method (PEM) as probability power flow calculation methodology. Then it establishes reactive power planning optimization formulation of distribution system which involves nodal voltage and branch power constraint as chance-constrained constraints and take distribution system probability voltage stability index as one of the multi-objective functions of the nonlinear optimal programming. To validate the proposed methodology, the IEEE33-bus system is taken as testing system which demonstrates the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of a Ka -band double balance mixer based on the marchand balun
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A Ka-band double balance mxer based on the marchand balun is proposed in this paper. The new design is simulated and validated by the measurement. Measured results show that about 10dB typical conversion loss, high gain compression and about 10dB return loss are achieved across the bandwidth from 27GHz to 44GHz, and LO-to-RF isolations are higher than 20dB.The results of conversion loss and isolation characteristic are the best among the same type mixer operating in ultra wideband millimeter wave frequency band in the reported paper.

articleTitle: WSN gait monitoring for objective evaluation of rehabilitation process
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A survey of wireless sensor network solutions for gait assessment is presented including own developed solution gait assessment based on smart insoles nodes ZigBee compatible characterized by multichannel force measurement and MEMS inertial measurement IMU. The system was developed to measure ground reaction force, acceleration and direction of feet in order to provide information to physiotherapists for an objective evaluation of rehabilitation effectiveness. Based on acquired data from the sensing channels a set of gait feature extraction such as walking speed stride length, swing time are calculated as part of gait analysis. Software for WSN node control, gait feature calculation and primary analysis of rehabilitation effectiveness developed for the physiotherapist was designed and implemented and preliminary tests were carried out for normal and simulated anomalous gait.

articleTitle: Large-signal impedance measurements of piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper reports the use of large-signal impedance measurements to study the behaviour of piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers (PUTs). The method requires only ordinary laboratory equipment including a signal generator, a digital oscilloscope together with a high frequency transformer. Equivalent circuit model parameters are extracted from the impedance measurement data of for investigating the device characteristics of the PUT. Such useful model parameter extraction is not possible from impedance measurements using even a sophistical LCR meter which is for small-signal impedance measurements. This low-cost and simple impedance measurement method is attractive for allowing even undergraduate students to perform research-related experiments.

articleTitle: Grey relational analysis for impact factors of micro-milling surface roughness
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Surface roughness is the most important index to evaluate micro-milling process. Surface roughness of the machined parts in the micro-milling process is mainly influenced by four cutting parameters (namely extended length of the micro-milling cutter, spindle speed, feed per tooth and cutting depth in the axial direction). The influence degree of the four parameters on surface roughness is not the same. It is of utmost important to learn the relational degree between each cutting parameter and surface roughness for accurately controlling surface roughness of the machined parts and efficiently guiding the practical machining process of the parts. Grey relational analysis is used to obtain the relational degree between each cutting parameter and surface roughness of the micro-milling parts. Through sample analysis, the feed per tooth fz has the most influence on surface roughness of the machined micro-milling parts, the relational degree between the feed per tooth fz and surface roughness Ra is 0.7688, while the extended length of the micro-milling cutter L has the least influence on surface roughness of the machined micro-milling parts, the relational degree between the extended length of the micro-milling cutter L and surface roughness Ra is 0.6054. In the practical micro-milling process, the four main cutting parameters may be reasonably chosen to accurately control surface roughness of the machined parts depending on the results of grey relational analysis.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis of rolling bearing based on wavelet packet energy feature and planar cloud model
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the uncertainties such as the strong randomness of feature information in the process of the rolling bearing fault diagnosis, misjudgment usually exists, and it causes reduced accuracy of the diagnosis. Thus the paper proposes a wavelet packet energy feature (WPEF) and planar cloud model (PCM) fault diagnosis method, PCM has the advantages of stable tendency and the ability in order to organically combine the fuzziness and the randomness. Firstly, the cloud models of fault concepts are obtained by using the wavelet packet to extract the energy characteristics of training sample from different fault. Then, the tested fault sample is used to extract the energy characteristics of wavelet packet, it is regarded as cloud droplets, then to classify it to realize fault diagnosis. The comparative experiments show the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A kind of method research of monopulse radar angular glint suppression
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To resolve the problem of near-range ship targets radar echoes crossing several Doppler units after MTD processing, a weighted area average method is proposed to solve the angular error, in which the angle measurements are filtered with weight of small window median. After the processing, the angular glint is suppressed efficiently while the measurement details are remained. Besides, the computational complexity keeps low. The manipulating results with measurement data show the method can effectively improve radar angle tracking precision by suppressing the angular glint significantly when the terminal guidance radar is approaching the target.

articleTitle: Rapid calibration technology on linear response workspace of CCD imaging system
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Calibration on linear response workspace of CCD imaging system is the base quantitatively analyzing optical signal character with CCD imaging. In this paper, based on grads diffuse reflectivity test card, researches rapid calibration technology on linear response workspace of CCD imaging system. Actual application indicates that this calibration technology can fulfil test need of CCD linear response workspace range under condition of faculative parameters combination and specifical spectrum range, can afford fiducial parameter for quantitatively analyzing optical signal character with CCD imaging.

articleTitle: Comparison of 2D & 3D models for simulations of electric-field in OVS
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, the basic principle of Optical Voltage Transformer (OVT) based on Pockels effect is introduced. A comparison is made between transverse Pockels effect and longitudinal Pockels effect. And OVT is unable to present the distribution of internal field directly. Therefore, it is necessary to simulate its electric filed, and the accuracy of the simulation results is important for OVT's design. For the axisymmetric model, in order to improve the efficiency of calculation a three-dimensional (3D) structure is usually simplified as a two-dimensional (2D) model. To compare and analyze the differences between the calculated results obtained by using OVT's voltage sensor head with 2D and 3D models, different shapes of BGO crystal in voltage sensor head are constructed respectively, and the finite element simulation software Ansoft Maxwell is used. The simulation results indicate that the maximum electric field intensity is quite different between 2D and 3D models of sensor head. And in the 3D simulation, different shapes of BGO crystal have different maximum electric field intensity of the sensor head. Compared with 2D simulation, 3D simulation is more real. So in an actual operation situation, it should analyze the OVT with 3D model.

articleTitle: The performance impact evaluation on bias of gyro and accelerometer for foot-mounted INS
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Foot-mounted inertial navigation system (INS) composed of MEMS-based inertial sensors is widely used in pedestrian navigation. The bias of gyro and accelerometer are the most important parameter which mainly determines the performance and the price of the device. How does the bias impact the performance of foot-mounted INS? How do we choose the suitable inertial sensors in the design of foot-mounted INS? This paper established the error state model and error observation model for foot-mounted INS and several typical constrains. Through the observability analysis of the error state variables, we deduced the conclusion that the east bias and north bias of accelerometer is the most important factor which impact navigation performance. An experiment designed specially verifies the correctness of the conclusion. The evaluation conclusion is very significant and helpful for the design of foot-mounted INS in pedestrian navigation.

articleTitle: Range-doppler and anti-interference performance of Cognitive Radar detection waveform
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Cognitive Radar could adjust its transmit waveform to get the best outperform in the alternative targets and environments with a close-loop feedback. It has been regarded as one of the tendency of radar. Optimization waveform design method is one of the critical technologies of radar cognition. This article analyses the range-doppler and anti-interference performance of a most common cognitive radar detection waveform. Firstly, the signal model and waveform solved process are reviewed, and the ambiguity function of the waveform is calculated and analyzed; secondly, the decrease of the output SNR of the cognitive radar caused by the white and colored interference are respectively derived; Finally, the MTLAB numerical simulation results are given.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of boundary scan test system based on EDIF
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Boundary scan test technology with its unique “virtual probe” characteristic provides a powerful means to solve the difficult problem of high density integrated test system components. It introduces the development of a more general boundary scan test system based on EDIF (Electronic Design Interchange Format). The hardware of the system is based on USB bus, including the PC, USB driver interface, the boundary scan test bus controller, test access port JTAG bus; software is based on XP system, through the Visual Studio 2008 as the programming environment, using SQLite3 database manages test module data. The test system can achieve the test and fault diagnosis. Finally the future development trend of boundary scan test technology is analyzed.

articleTitle: Remove the time base drift of sampling oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The time base drift is a key factor that influences the sampling oscilloscope to measure the high speed pulse signal precisely, so time base drift must be removed as far as possible. Cross-correlation algorithm is an alternative method to remove time base drift effectively. First, this paper does computer simulation, then use the algorithm to do research on the original data that is collected when establishing national pulse parameters primary standard. Both the results of simulation and the research show that the cross-correlation algorithm can remove the time drift effectively.

articleTitle: A novel reconfigurable three-way power divider constructed on unitary plane
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a reconfigurable three-way power divider constructed on unitary plane worked at 2GHz is proposed. The proposed circuit has total seven states in the three-way mode, the two-way mode and the single-way mode. The power divider is designed mathematically to have good matching performance and high isolation with novel reconfigurable impedance matching network and isolation impedance switch network. By adjusting the parameters of PIN diode under forward bias or reverse bias, both of networks can achieve different transmission states. For the three-way mode, insertion loss is about 4.87dB and the return losses of each port are higher than 25dB. For the two-way mode with three states, the insertion losses is about 3.2dB, the return losses of port1 and transmission ports are more than 25dB. For the single-way mode with three states, the insertion loss is about 0.2dB; the return losses of each port are higher than 28dB at 2GHz.

articleTitle: Design of multiple-standard signal source for quartz wafer testing
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper designs a high-precision signal source based on DDS (Direct Digital Frequency Synthesis) technology for the needs of quartz wafer parametric testing system in π-network. Using Oven Controlled Crystal Oscillator (OCXO) as the time base, the signal source uses AD9959 integrated chipof the AD Company in American, and is controlled by ARM micro-controller.The signal source can generate four-channel sinusoidal signals whichranges from1 to 200MHz and itsfrequency, phase and amplitude can be independently adjusted. This technologyprovides technical support for quartz wafer parametric testing system and improves the accuracy of measurement of quartz wafer. This paper analyses the equivalent circuits of quartz wafer unit, the π-network, the select of chips, the principle of DDS technology and the hardware and software design of DDS signal source. Among them, AD9959 is a high-performance DDS chip with four channels, and its internal clock frequency can reach 500MHz, furthermore, the chip is integrated with four independent DDS channels and its composed of 32-bit frequency control registers; The STM32F407 chip is used which comes with three 12-bit ADCs, two 12-bit DACs and two USB ports and can simplify the external circuit and facilitate the realization of the control of the entire system, so it provides convenient conditions for the testing system. The experimental results show that the frequency error of the signal source is less than ± 0.1ppm, and the accuracy of the series resonant frequency of the quartz wafer testing system can reach ± 2ppm when using the signal source.Compared with the testing instruments widely used in China, which are based on oscillator and impedance testing methods, this testing system has the advantages of wide frequency testing range, fast frequency switching speed, high frequency resolution and accuracy. The signal source meets the requirements of the quartz wafer testing system very well.

articleTitle: Test point optimization of control moment gyro (CMG) based on multi-signal flow model and improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The increasing integration degree of circuits in electronic systems makes faults detection and isolation more and more difficult. Design for testability (DFT) was applied to solve the problem. In this procedure, designers are required to set an optimum arrangement of sensors to achieve the best testability. But the search of the best test points combination is usually conducted by manual work. To simplify this blind and inefficient procedure, a test point optimization algorithm based on multi-signal flow model is proposed in this paper and is successfully applied in a CMG. First, the basic conception of modeling is introduced and the analysis of testability is converted to the calculation based on dependency matrix. Then the test points optimization problem is described and analyzed by an improved genetic algorithm. At last, the algorithm is examined by the CMG's A/D board subsystem. The result shows the algorithm can find the best solution with excellent efficiency.

articleTitle: Hierarchical built-in test equipment of circuit system based on boundary scan
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A hierarchical built-in test equipment of circuit system based on boundary scan, which consists of subsystem-level BITE, board-level BITE and component-level BITE, is presented. Structure and working principle of each level BITE is introduced in detail, after giving the hierarchical structure. Experiment is also carried out to verify the design. The system could combine the strong information obtaining ability in the inferior level BITE and the powerful information processing ability in superior level BITE to enhance the overall test capability of complex circuit system. It can be used for fault diagnosis and isolation of complex hierarchical circuit system in satellite and other spacecraft.

articleTitle: A design for four-terminal-pair resistor with calculable frequency dependence
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Since the AC resistance measuring meter and the bridge adopt measurement principle of the four-terminal-pair, but the resistor with calculable frequency dependence is usually the four-terminal structure. So it is necessary to design a four-terminal-pair resistor with calculable frequency dependence. This paper introduces the 100Ω coaxial resistor with calculable frequency dependence based on four-terminal-pair. It introduces the structure and parameters of the resistance sample, builds the coaxial resistance's mathematical model and calculates the related parameters. Calculated AC-DC difference is only a few parts in 10−11 at a frequency of 1kHz, the time constant of the resistance is 3.6×10−9s. By comparing with the measuring result, both have a good consistency.

articleTitle: Improved method of restraining taper error in GFSINS
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The taper error exists with new character in Gyroscope-free Strap-down Inertial Navigation System. For GFSINS can't give out angle increment directly when adopting Equivalent Rotation Vector Algorithm with four samples, new calculating method was designed and optimized to improve the efficiency of attitude refreshing. At last, the coefficient in the calculating formula of equivalent rotation vector was optimized by Chaos Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm. The simulation result showed that it could eliminate the influence of taper error effectively and improve the navigation precision.

articleTitle: A numerical control attenuator based method of power agility in signal generators
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Power agility is a crucial technology in modern signal generators, which guarantees the performance of frequency agility in a large number of military issues. In this paper a novel method of power agility based on numerical control attenuator is proposed. Also the traditional power control methods based on ALC system are reviewed, and the shortcoming is analysed. Then the detailed design process of the proposed method is elaborated. In this method a special circuit is designed to replace CPU which was used to transfer control command in order to shorten the operation time remarkably. This circuit contains three parts, such as bus controller, data transmission bus and command decoder. The flexibility and validity of the proposed method are analysed concisely and also tested by an actual experiment. The experiment results show that the power agility time can be shortened in 55ns at a carrier frequency of 1GHz based on a 16dB attenuator. This method has been adopted by some types of commercial signal generators.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the partial discharge development of the fixed protrusion on the enclosure defect in GIS
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents experiments of the fixed protrusion on the enclosure defect on a 220 kV GIS equipment using UHF partial discharge measurement. PD data was captured by UHF detection used an oscilloscope and stored as phase resolved pulse sequence (PRPS) data. Then, the multiple PD patterns such as phase resolved pulse sequence analysis (PRPSA) pattern, phase resolved partial discharge (PRPD) pattern and Δu pattern can be calculated from the PRPS data sets. In addition, partial discharge trend curves are also to be used to depict the PD developed process. The multiple discharge patterns and PD parameters observed in this paper give a valuable PD characteristic interpretation and further research of PD pattern identification.

articleTitle: Combined utilization of analysis instruments: Trace impurity detection for purity xenon
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Xenon, a very valuable gas product, is also a critical material used in the fields of industry and scientific research. The purity analysis for xenon thus becomes very important. However, one instrument cannot accomplish the whole analysis because there are several impurities existed in it. In this study, a combined analysis approach was designed. 10 kinds of impurities were detected by GC, GC-MS and CRDS. The final concentrations calculated for all the impurities were lower than 1 µmol/mol, even the level of 0.001 µmol/mol could also be detected. It shows that the methods are very sensitive. The repeatability was evaluated via the relative standard deviations (RSDs), which were 0.11%∼6.29% for the concentration level of 0.01 µmol/mol∼1.41 µmol/mol. This gives an acceptable repeatability for analyzing quite low concentration levels. As described, a combined analysis method with three instruments depending on their own features and capabilities was developed and evaluated, the experimental data supporting that the method are sensitive, simple and acceptable for purity analysis of xenon.

articleTitle: The design and development of LXI trigger box
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Triggering is a key issue in the distributed test system. As a basis for the distributed test system, Networked Test Instruments are required to support more trigger modes<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. But in the distributed test system, sometimes each instrument has many different trigger modes. It leads that instruments can't directly trigger each other. Therefore, these different trigger modes are difficult to be managed for system. Now the LXI trigger box is introduced in the paper. It is based on LXI bus (LAN-based eXtensions for Instrumentation) and supports a variety of LAN trigger modes. The instrument connected on the box can visit the LAN and trigger other instruments. The LXI trigger box can manage all kinds of Networked Test Instruments' trigger problems, which brings the convenience to build a distributed test system. The Trigger Box supports the IEEE1588-2008 Precision Time Synchronization Protocol through the timestamp information carried by the LAN message. The trigger time of instruments can be specified, which is very important to the occasion that requires precise time-triggered coordination between instruments. The average synchronization accuracy of Trigger Boxes is ± 13ns which can meet requirements for most applications.

articleTitle: Terahertz beam waveguide feed cassegrain quasi-optical mono-pulse antenna test system
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Antenna performance measurement is an important research topic to improve the overall quality of terahertz radar system. An efficient antenna test system is necessary for high performance radar system. In this paper, a near-field terahertz beam waveguide feed cassegrain quasi-optical mono-pulse antenna test system is proposed according to the characteristics of high frequency of terahertz and the test difficulty of terahertz antenna. The and-differential comparator and feed system of our terahertz mono-pulse antenna system are in the structure of quasi-optical, which can reduces the energy transmission loss, simple structure, easy processing relative to waveguide structure when the electromagnetic wave propagates in space in beam bunching. The system is fixed on the quasi-optical table, and can test the performance of the antenna effectively. The system also realizes real time display and the automatic formatted storage. It is proved to run stably, have high reliability and meet the demand for actual applications.

articleTitle: Ground penetrating radar imaging with a simple MIMO array
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A simple Multiple-Input Multiple-Output antenna array for ground penetrating radar imaging is presented in this paper. The antenna array only consists of a linear transmit array composed of four antennas and a linear receive array composed of six antennas. The length of this array is about 90cm and the width is 12cm. An algorithm named modified Kirchhoff Migration is adopted, and 2-D and 3-D imaging simulations of three ideal scattering points ware implemented to prove its practical applicability in the end. It is shown that focused images can be obtained with the simple MIMO array for the ground penetrating radar imaging.

articleTitle: Design of a new millimeter wave power combiner based on spatial power-combining technique
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a new 16-way millimeter wave power combiner based on spatial power-combining technique is proposed and designed. The resistive film is placed in the branch of the combiner to improve the port isolation. The structure has advantages of easy fabrication, high isolation, low loss and a wide operation band of 33%. The structure is simulated and optimized at V band by using HFSS. The combiner has demonstrated operation over a broadband of 50 GHz to 75 GHz with more than 12 dB return loss and less than 6.5 dB insertion loss. The simulated results illustrate very good match to the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation of complex electromagnetic environment complexity based on a method of the cosine vector included angle
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the complex electromagnetic environment becomes the main characteristic of modern war, military training under complicated electromagnetic environment is taken seriously and the complex electromagnetic environment has become one of research hot spots. On the degree of complex electromagnetic environment for scientific classification, correct measures, so as to form a complete set of reflect the internal logic structure of complex electromagnetic environment change rule and the external display system, in order to accurately image analysis, grasp and control the battlefield electromagnetic momentum, has become the top priority. In this paper, the method of the cosine vector included angle is used to evaluate complexity of complex electromagnetic environment. Evaluation index system is needed to set up to assess the complexity of the electromagnetic environment. In this paper short-wave communication is evaluated by the rate of abnormal signal, large signal rate, time possession, spatial coverage, channel occupancy degrees, the average power spectral density and the Background noise intensity. We use the example in the literature [9] for solving and analysis. Test data of the shortwave receiver intercepted in accordance with the frequency spectrum is divided into three test evaluation, respectively 15.0015.33MHz, 15.3315.66MHz, 15.6615.99MHz. Electromagnetic environment of three days in each frequency band is used the object of assessment, Seven indicators' data of Three evaluation object is gotten. By formula (10) measurement of electromagnetic environment complexity in 3 bands is gotten, Respectively 0.9998, 0.6999 and 0.3701., the results are basically identical with the results in the literature [9]. In this paper, the complexity of the complex electromagnetic environment assessment is quantified by using Method of the cosine vector included angle. Complexity quantitative evaluation of the short wave electromagnetic environment has been carried out to verify the complexity of the instance. The instance results show that the Method of the cosine vector included angle can be used to assess the complexity of the electromagnetic environment. As to whether this method can be used to calculate the complexity of the other types of electromagnetic environment, further research is needed.

Author Keywords: method of the cosine vector included angle

articleTitle: Study on the test method for a frequency converter with an embedded local oscillator in satellite
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Beginning with the test demand of frequency converter with embedded local oscillator in satellite, this paper, combining the technical feature of multifunctional vector network analyzer, puts forward a precise test method, which is based on frequency tracking and vector mixer calibration technique regarding the test requirement of group delay and conversion loss of frequency converter with embedded local oscillator. Through the result, we can see that the test method is accurate, feasible and can provide effective technical measures for the performance testing and evaluation of the frequency converter with embedded local oscillator in satellite.

articleTitle: Research on infrared diagnosis of circuit based on data fusion
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Circuit diagnosis usually take voltage or current as its input. This contact method has deficiencies of variation of data input during testing and inaccessibility of inevitable nodes. On the other hand, non-contact diagnosis, such as temperature or magnetic field diagnosis, also has its defects of inaccuracy of data and insufficiency of algorithms. The paper acquires contact data of voltage and non-contact data of temperature of circuit under test. It diagnoses the circuit by contact and non-contact method separately, and then fuses the two results into a final one. It makes good use of the advantages of both contact and non-contact diagnosis but makes up for the deficiencies of the two. The experiment shows the combined method gets the best fault coverage and resolution among the three methods.

articleTitle: New method for measurement of waveform capture rate using random signal
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Waveform capture rate is one of the most important indicators of digital storage oscilloscope, representing the ability of the system to capture waveforms in unit time. But for the actual acquisition systems, it is difficult to measure this indicator only by its external characteristics. In this paper, by analyzing the relation between the waveform capture rate and the dead-time of DSO, the new measurement method based on random pulse signal for waveform capture rate is proposed, and then this method has been verified in the actual system and gives the test results accordingly.

articleTitle: Design of polarization insensitive and wide angle metamaterial absorber
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a polarization insensitive and wide angle metamaterial absorber based on the electromagnetic resonance was designed. The absorber consists of electrical metal ring resonator, lossy medium and full-metal film. We applied different polarization of vertical incident electromagnetic waves and oblique incident electromagnetic waves respectively on the surface of the absorber, and conducted an electromagnetic simulation on the structure. The results show that the absorption rates for different vertical polarization incident electromagnetic waves were 99.9%, which indicates that the absorber has a high absorption and insensitive-polarization. When the angle of incidence increases to 60s, absorbing rate remained above 83.4%, and the absorber shows a wide angle of incidence characteristics. By the analysis of RCS(Radar Cross Section), the absorber has a good RCS reduction feature, indicating that the absorber has potential applications in electromagnetic shielding, stealth, detection and other fields.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a test platform for the preloaded assembly of harmonic reducer
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, we design an automation test platform for the preloaded assembly of harmonic reducer, it can realize multi parameter measurement with high precision. The device is composed of electric control system and test workbench, electric control system including PC104 control unit, sensors and signal conditioning circuit, signal acquisition and control board, motor control card, serial communication module, servo motor and controller. The equipment can test pre-tightening force of harmonic reducer, starting torque, frictional moment and shaft stiffness. By experimental verification, this test platform measurement precision is better than the actual testing requirements, and the system has the advantages of simple operation, stable performance.

articleTitle: Design of a missile launcher test system based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of development and field test, a missile launcher test system is designed based on virtual instrument and PCI bus. The composition, working principle, hardware and software structure of the system are introduced. Some key techniques, such as multithreading technology, signal processing and data storage under Labwindows/CVI environment are expatiated. It has been used in development and experiment of a new missile launcher. Application proves that the system has the advantages of easy implementation, high reliability and good operability.

articleTitle: Design realization of an improved high directional coupler with ultra wideband
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel improved high directional coupler with super wide frequency band was designed in this paper. The device is composed of a coaxial-cable balun and a resistance power divider circuit. The coaxial-cable balun make signals transfer from unbalance to balance, and the power divider redistribute the two signals outputted from the balance ports of coaxial-cable balun. The two sections together realized signals directional transmission. To improve the wideband performance we introduced coupling capacitor design technique and thick film workmanship. The coupling capacitor design introduced into the device can repair the lower frequency response error of the coaxial-cable balun balance ports. The printed resistance can improve the high frequency working performance of the power divider. We firstly emulated the design using Serenade. The schematic model was built using thick film models and coupling capacitor chosen from the passive device library. The simulation results met our expectations that the working band was expanded. Then the assuming was verified in experiments. The directional coupler was tested using vector network analyzer. The test result showed that the novel directional coupler expanded the low work frequency limit to 100 kHz and the high work frequency limit to 40GHz. The directivity in the whole frequency range was larger than 15dB. The directivity was larger than 20dB in low frequency section (100 kHz~45MHz). The thick film also elevated the power capacity and the fighting against static wearing ability. In conclusion, resistance power divider has significant influence on the final character of the directional coupler, effective mend on resistance circuit and fair matching of resistance power divider circuit with coaxial-cable balun are available ways to improve the directional coupler.

articleTitle: Development of appliqué Sensor Interface Module based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Rapid satellite deployment is the primary goal of Space Plug-and-Play Architecture (SPA), the Appliqué Sensor Interface Module (ASIM) is necessary for Non-SPA compliant components to be converted into SPA compliant. Focusing on current ASIM not supporting power hot swap, a SPA-S (SpaceWire) ASIM with power hot swap capability was designed and developed. The FPGA was used to convert device-specific protocol to SPA protocol, the on-board flash was adopted to store xTEDS which describe SPA component information, and the 28V voltage power hot swap capability was realized by hot swap power manager. The SPA-S ASIM could convert Non-SPA components into SPA-S compliant. It means that the Non-SPA Component could be more effectively introduced into SPA system by the SPA-S ASIM.

articleTitle: New calibration of simplifying through connections on multiport VNA
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Before measuring a multiport DUT (device under test), we should calibrate multiport VNA to reduce the systematic errors. It is import to reduce the calibrating steps. The paper explores a new method to decrease calibrating steps by computing redundant error parameters. This method can decrease through connections from C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to n-1, reduce errors of repeating connections, and avoid operation mistakes. This method can also avoid non-insertable calibration. The new method has been used successfully to measure an airline.

articleTitle: Measurement and calibration device for frequency standard
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Unified time system is an important part of the test system. The important task is to ensure that test command and control system, measurement and control system for time accurate and uniform. The reliability and accuracy directly affect the test results. In order to ensure the reliability of time unified system that provides a signal, timing frequency accuracy, stability, reproduce, daily frequency drift and phase noise measurement verification. Research gapless sampling frequency difference multiplication method of frequency standard time domain characteristics were measured; Using a digital phase locked loop technique realizes quartz frequency standard in cesium beam atomic frequency standard of synchronous tracking, the quartz frequency source both with low phase noise and high stability of output frequency, with a cesium atomic frequency standard with high accuracy and long-term stability characteristics<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>; The design of low phase noise frequency divider module realizes multi-channel measurement timing frequency standard, improving the metering guarantee efficiency. After verification, system frequency standard calibration device can realize timing frequency standard in the laboratory and in the field of metrology to support and enhance equipment performance validation and testing capabilities.

articleTitle: Stereo matching using pixel classification and dual-weighted guided filter
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Finding the subjectively correct binocular disparity of a stereopair has long been a challenging issue for researchers. A coarse-to-fine algorithm is presented in this article for seeking to a more reasonable solution to this issue. We focus on the disparity computation other than disparity refinement and post-processing procedures. Dual-weighted guided filter or a simplified guided image filter with dual-weights is proposed to boost computation efficiency and reduce matching ambiguity. Perceived as a classification step, a normalized cross-correlation based method aims for searching for reliable matching candidates. Three channels in RGB colour space are biologically weighted for subjectively rational correspondence. As comparative experimental results show, the proposed method performs excellently without post-processing. All the algorithms are tested on Middlebury stereopsis benchmark.

articleTitle: Trace moisture measurement system based on microcontroller methodological
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To measure the moisture in insulating material of the HV equipment, an on-line trace moisture measurement method based on MCU is introduced in this paper. The system is designed based on a single chip AT89C52. An alumina humidity sensor is employed to sense the humidity of the insulating material. Before being processed in the single chip, a pulse modulation circuit, low pass filter, amplifier and A/D converter are used to convert the humidity signal to digital signal. Then, the single chip processes the digital signal and display or print the humidity value. The system is implemented in the assemble language. The experiments in a private machinery factory show that our system can successfully monitor the humidity.

articleTitle: Research on the best acquisition parameters of NaI digital spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on virtual instrument ideas, a set of NaI digital spectrum measurement system is designed and structured. For the FJ374 type NaI (Tl) scintillation detector and specific radioactive source (<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup>Co radioactive source, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">137</sup>Cs radioactive source), the best acquisition parameters of the digital spectrum measurement system is determined through research and experiments. The optimum measurement parameters of the NaI(Tl) scintillation detector is as follows: falling edge trigger sampling mode, acquisition range is 1V, the trigger threshold is -0.05V, the sampling rate is greater than 32M/s, sampling length is 300 points.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of self-test system in signal generators
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A flexible self-test function becomes crucial in the processes of debugging, production and user site testing in modern intelligent signal generators. In this paper, a design and implementation method of self-test system in signal generators are elaborated with respect to the overall architecture, driver program, data structure, self-test node binary tree traversal algorithm and software processing flow, etc‥ In addition, the availability of the proposed self-test system design method is verified via the actual circuit and software of a certain type of signal generator.

articleTitle: Measurement technique of crosslink signal quality parameter for navigation satellite
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Signal quality parameters represented electrical properties of the onboard equipment and have a major impact on the main task of crosslink. The traditional microwave signal quality assessment is to analyze the signal after down-converted and nonlinear distortion is introduced. To overcoming the fault of classical method, a technique using digital processing algorithm has been proposed. The crosslink signal is directly sampling by high speed sampler. Coherent receiving and demodulating are done base on soft defined technology, then the quality parameters can be analyzed such as phase consistence, phase error of IQ branch, eye pattern, correlation loss, etc. The actual signal evaluation results show that the accuracy of the proposed analytical method satisfy the crosslink signal quality parameter analysis.

articleTitle: A new ultra-wideband multi-way coaxial power combiner
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel ultra-wideband multi-way coaxial power combiner is presented in this paper. In the new structure, there is an extended coaxial waveguide cavity, where the microwave signal can be transmitted smoothly with little reflection, and 24 ultra-wideband coupling probe of great efficiency. The transmission waveguide type is changed from coaxial waveguide to parallel boards at the edge of the extended coaxial waveguide cavity. For 6GHz-18GHz ultra-wideband application, the output port of the coupling probe is technically designed with the λ/4 impedance matching. Simulation and measured results well agree with each other, showing that the insertion loss SR<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> is around -2dB and the return loss SR<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> is below -10dB, which is practically feasible for ultra-wideband power combining.

articleTitle: Digital geographic information based complex electromagnetic environment signal simulation and generation
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The semi-physical simulation test method is the research focus of electronic warfare equipment performance evaluation test in complex electromagnetic environment. The complex electromagnetic environment signal generation technology based on digital geographic information is an effective technical approach to implement semi-physical simulation test. In this paper, the idea, method and current development of this technology was introduced from three aspects, i.e. simulation modeling in complex electromagnetic environment, electromagnetic signal propagation simulation based on digital geographic information, and complex-type signal generation.

articleTitle: A fully automatic folding stage control strategy
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Ordinary folding stage is too heavy to fold by people, so it is necessary to design a new type of automatic folding stage which using the mechanical and electrical control technology, relying on the electric drive to fold or expand the stage, and give a practical and effective control strategy. Introduces the structure of automatic folding stage, describes the movement principle and the control idea of a single set of stage in detail, and presents the control strategy of many stages combination to fold or expand in detail. This control strategy have simple logic, it is easy to write programs, and it can ensure the stage operation is safety and orderly.

articleTitle: The analysis of two-way time transfer precision caused by shiping
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The precision time synchronization is of great significance for aerospace, digital communications and deep space exploration etc. The synchronous frequency and time of different node devices are very critical when multi-systems are highly coordinated. Due to the signal propagation path is approximately symmetrical in two-way time transfer(TWTT), The effect of path delay error to a great extent have been offset, so the time synchronous precision is improved. This method got the attention of time transfer research department every countries. The principle and system composition of TWTT are described. The factors influencing the time synchronous precision are deduced through analysis of signal transfer link. It includes time-interval measurement error, system error of the equipment, signal propagation delay error in air, and delay error caused by shippig et. Delay errors caused by shippig is analyzed in detail. Delay error mathematical model caused by shippig is set up. Using the second-order expansion Taylor, the delay error caused by movement velocity and acceleration of ships are deduced. The delay error caused by shippig of TWTT is below 0.1ns through theoretical analysis and calculation.

articleTitle: Passive intermodulation analyzer for satellite communication antenna
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: PIM (passive intermodulation) satellite antenna products were introduced. Then the main low PIM process was summarized, such as the main equipment and the special requirements of the plating process for the material requirements. To establish a PIM analyzer technique were discussed, such as reducing the number of joints and preventing the active intermodulation of isolator. According to characteristics of the low PIM process and the satellite communication antenna, the measurement method and the PIM analyzer were designed. After calibration, the analyzer reached the design target.

articleTitle: A optimized spur-reduction delta-sigma modulator for wideband frequency synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A spur-reduction technique is presented to achieve low fractional spurs for a 5-10 GHz frequency synthesizer. A wideband fractional-N frequency synthesizer is designed with digital multi-stage noise shaping (MASH) Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM). The third-order MASH Structure (MASH 1-1-1) is optimized using FPGA for spur-reduction. It exhibits in-band fractional spur of -66.85dBc/Hz at 50 kHz offset and improved about 18dBc/Hz at 9 GHz. The theory of Fractional-N frequency synthesizers is also presented.

articleTitle: The optimization of steam temperature control system based on pole assignment
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Specific to the defect that when smith-predictor model mismatch, its control quality gets worse, a steam temperature control system model build on state observer that based on pole assignment was designed. The model makes several constant coefficients first-order damp elements approximate controlled object by using pole assignment, the observer output can feedback in advance to the system by PD controller, to overcome the effect of lagging link and uncertainty of the system, and differential effect can eliminate the dynamic deviation of the system. Meanwhile, simulate the optimization model combined with a second-order controlled object which has an integration element. Through the simulation experiment shows that the system has better dynamic performance and control quality build by this method, provides a way to eliminate the influence of lag link in the steam temperature control system.

articleTitle: Development of OPC server in a remote industrial control system
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the needs of a large domestic power plant engineering, we had developed a remote industrial control system — GKS system. This project is the development of the OPC Server system in the GKS subsystem. This paper studied OPC technology specification is getting widely used in the industrial process control field, and development process based on the specification for the OPC server design of GKS system. The subsystem provides the data for application software of iFix host PC, and receives the control and configuration information from the application software. At the same time, the system provides control and configuration information of customers for hardware process, and collects data from the hardware process to prepare use by the application program. The system had realized safe and reliable communication between the iFix host PC application software and DCS control module. The OPC driver developed after the test has been applied in practical engineering. The communication with good performance was realized between monitor and control system of domestic self-developed based on Ethernet protocol and iFix5.1 configuration software. The system has good universality, flexibility and openness. The communication was realized between monitor-control system of domestic self-developed based on Ethernet protocol and iFix5.1 configuration software.

articleTitle: Dynamic spectrum analysis of bogie noise of high-speed train
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to understand the dynamic changes of bogie noise and its contribution to condition monitoring and the influence on the passenger comfort, the dynamic spectrum is used for analysis and research. Dynamic spectrum is a three-dimensional spectrum which is build on the time - frequency analysis, the research results show that the dynamic spectrum can fully reflect the time varying characteristic, spectral structure and dynamic range of bogie noise, and it is sensitive to the changes of train operation status, operation speed and track condition, bogie running noise is one of the main noise source high-speed train, thus research results has important application value on noise reduction, the monitoring of train operation status and comfort level evaluation of passenger compartment noise.

articleTitle: Study of the far field intensity distribution measurement of large-aperture laser beam
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The far field intensity distribution measurement is an important content of performance evaluation for space laser communication, laser radar terminals. There are several beam profilers commercially available, but these systems are always used for small-aperture laser beam. This paper is mainly described how to measure the far field distribution for large-aperture laser beam of space laser communication terminals. There is a detailed introduction on the optical design of measuring system. The field of view, operating wavelength, focal length and aperture of camera lens are respectively introduced. The system provides a new way to measure large-aperture laser parameter, which has the advantage of high resolution for intensity distribution measurement.

articleTitle: Component based representation for face recognition
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper we propose a component based face recognition method. In the framework, the facial landmarks is detected by using a view invariant AAM, and the components including eyes, nose, and mouth are extracted. To improve recognition rate, the components are aligned by using the procruetes analysis. After aligning, the component is insensitive to translation, scale, and rotation. The face features are extracted by applying a random measurement matrix on the input component image. The obtained features are in a low dimensional space which saves computation time. For face recognition, Gradient projection is used to resolve the convex problem in norm minimization and determine the class to which the test face image belong. Finally, the presented method is demonstrated on the Extended Yalu face database. The results demonstrate that the method performs well in face recognition.

articleTitle: Calibration method of insulation oil tester based on the electric calculation for electrode structure
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The calibration of the insulation oil tester (IOT) should simulate the actual operating state of device. It is recommended that the calibration apparatus have the same impedance with insulation oil vessel. This paper built models using finite element method and calculated capacitance values for different oil vessel structure. Besides, high-precision LCR electrical bridge was used to measure capacitances of different electrode structure and by the result of which the middle-grounded double capacitance divider vector signal measurement standard was developed. The experiment results indicated that the designed calibration apparatus could effectively match the impedance of the oil vessel and satisfy the traceability of vector quantity output value of the insulation oil tester with adequate accuracy.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of local contrast method for infrared small target detection
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Infrared (IR) small target detection has become an important technology in infrared searching and tracking system, infrared radar warning system and infrared imaging tracking system. Among several computational models we use a local contrast method (LCM) to detect IR small target which is inspired by human vision system (HVS) and derived kernel (DK) model. This paper presents a system architecture which employs a field-programmable gate array (FPGA) as the hardware processing platform for small target detection in infrared image at low signal-noise ratio (SNR). Performance of the IR small target detection system will be evaluated by performing several experiments. The platform based on FPGA will provide high computational performance to satisfy the real-time processing and low power consumption requirements.

articleTitle: EMD filter algorithm for self-mixing interference displacement sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Considering the issue of noise reduction associated with self-mixing interference (SMI), the paper presented an empirical mode decomposition (EMD) filter algorithm for SMI laser sensor that enables more accurate reconstruction of the displacement information from an SMI signal. The performance of the algorithm is studied. It is shown that the algorithm are capable of removing white noise and high frequency noise and so on. The phase unwrapping displacement reconstructions method based on this algorithm have been experimentally validated, with laser subject to the weak and moderate feedback regime, strong feedback regime. The experimental results shown that the method could reduce reconstruction error in simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of self-sustaining piezoelectric power supply for floating bridge monitoring wireless sensor
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Using wireless sensor network to carry out status monitoring for floating bridge structure will improve the reliability and effectiveness of monitoring system greatly. To solve power supply problem of the network nodes, this paper designs a kind of self-sustaining piezoelectric power supply. It converts the mechanical energy which produced in the floating bridge's work environment into vibration excitation source, so as to extend the load's continuous effect and correspondingly extend the power supply time; Applly ANSYS to carry out dynamic power generation characteristics simulation analysis of self-sustaining piezoelectric structure, make qualitative analysis on the effect principle of the relevant parameters on the power generation characteristics. Then built Maxite hammer machine test system to simulate the impact test. The research results show that the new power supply is able to collect the impact energy efficiently, and improve the electromechanical conversion efficiency greatly.

articleTitle: The influence of load standard on VNA single port measurement accuracy
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Vector Network Analyzer is a type of widely used microwave measurement instrument. It can achieve high measurement accuracy for its calibration function. In Calibration, the instrument measures a series of calibration standards of which characteristics are known to quantify the error items of the instrument. The error will be corrected during measurement. The measurement accuracy is related to the accuracy of the calibration standards. Calibration standards will cause error for they are not perfect. Load standard is different from ideal match, so it is one of the most important factor to influence measurement accuracy. In this paper, the author illustrated the principle of single-port network measurement, and introduced error sources and calibration model. Then the author analyzed and calculated the measurement error when using fixed load standard. Afterward, the measurement error caused by slide load standard was analyzed. In the end, other factors affect measurement accuracy were pointed out.

articleTitle: Design of auto-verification serial bus in microwave instrument
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the design of the serial bus protocol and the controller, this paper proposes a novel serial bus to verify the serial reading and writing operation of the address and the data. This serial bus can be applied to the maneuverable control of the circuit board with the host CPU in microwave instrument. It can reduce the volume of the parallel bus, unexpected disturbances and the complexity of the master board, which can improve the communication of the instruments in the integrated system.

articleTitle: Multi-port embedded debugger agent for heterogeneous multi-core ASIP debug
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the past several years, we are all the witness of complex multi-core processors' growing. In the meanwhile, more and more engineers and researchers dedicate to multi-core processor program development. Debug isan essential part in most of program development and efficient debugging can fix the bugs in development more quickly.It is hard for a GDB session to debug multiply cores at the same time like the traditional debugging way, especially, debugging heterogeneous multi-core processor. This paper puts forward a multi-port embedded debugger agent for heterogeneous multi-core ASIP (Application Specific Instruction-set Processor) debugging. The multi-port debugger agent will bind numbers of IP ports and each port corresponds to a core in ASIP, therefore each debugger host can debug corresponding core independently and remotely via TCPat the same time. The construction of debugger agent includes 3 sections: RSP processing part, monitorand JTAG (Joint Test Action Group)[1]driver.RSP processing and monitor are made up with multiply threads. Monitor is a single thread, and the RSP processing part's thread number should be the same as the core number which you want to debug. The communication between debugger agent and debugger host is based on RSP, which is mean debugger agent is compatible with GDB, the most popular C and C++ debugger.Each core in ASIP is independent, that means it has its own program memory, data memory and register memory. Meanwhile, every core can access others' memories for data sharing.Every debugger host can load binary program, setting breakpoints, single stepping, reading data from register and memory and monitoring status of the core etc. for the core it supported.User can debug heterogeneous multi-core ASIP like debugging other general purpose processor. Multi-port debuggeragent is simple, reliable and efficient method for debugging heterogeneous multi-core ASIP.
