Experimental results on ITC'02 SOC test benchmarks indicate that our method can provide shorter test time compared with recent works.

articleTitle: Model order estimation for sparse wideband signal compressive sensing
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Compressive sampling (CS) has been wildly investigated in wideband signal spectrum sensing. A variety of signal reconstruction algorithms are reported for CS. Usually, the eigenvalues of covariance matrix of compressive measurements are used to estimate signal model order. However, due to the noise introduced in the sampling stage and the finite length of sampling data, the performance of signal model order estimation would be degraded. In this paper, we present a model order estimation approach for CS signal reconstruction. The proposed approach is based on minimum description length (MDL) criterion, which is used to distinguish between signal subspace and noise subspace. We evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm in the framework of modulated wideband converter (MWC), which is designed based on CS. It is shown that the signal model order can be reliably estimated using the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on effect of loop cable coupling within the cavity of EMP
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on FDTD theories and algorithms, through CST modeling and simulation, the article analyses the rules of nuclear electromagnetic pulse on loop cable coupling within the cavity. The following conclusions were obtained: for loop cable wires, when the polarization direction of the magnetic field in the cavity is perpendicular to the loop plane, the magnetic inductive current is maximum, and in the loop, the coupling current of the cable which is parallel to the direction of the electric field is maximum, and coupled energy on its cable is also proportional to cable resistance value. The conclusion provides the important basis for NEMP protection.

articleTitle: Optimized sample method of weapon testability based on GSPN & AHP
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Currently, testability is regarded more and more important by manufactories during weapon is designed and has become vital characteristics of weapon availability. It is important test item of approval test and important component of weapon efficiency. In this paper, According to the demand of testability test during approval test, certain weapon testability requirement model is constructed based on generalized stochastic Petri nets (GSPN), testability indexed importance is computed based on testability indexes value; This weapon analytic hierarchy graph is constructed based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP), through analysing and reasoning three hierarchy structure, the weight coefficient about sample distribution and selection principle based on GSPN & AHP were established.

articleTitle: Research on the improvement of target localization method based on magnetometers array
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The marine magnetic target localization is a technology for calculating the targets' parameters about location, magnetic moment, distance from detecting instruments in the sea, by using the magnetic signals which are received from submarine magnetometers. The traditional submarine magnetometers array is substituted by five-point symmetrical array in this article. Through the calculation, it can be found that the computational error by using the new array is reduced, and the positioning accuracy is doubled under the same conditions. In addition, a discriminate compensation method is adopted to reduce the singular value of magnetic target localization error in the vicinity of Y. All this research provides a reliable test method for marine magnetic target of accurate positioning.

articleTitle: A kind of charge integration amplifying circuit for radiation-measuring device
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Micro-current whose value is less than 1uA is an important kind of expression form of the interaction between radial and matter. In this paper, three kinds of micro-current measurement method were compared at first. Then, a pA level current measurement system designed with capacitor integration method used in radial test was described. The basic design principle and its calculation formulas such as low cut-off frequency, high cut-off frequency, noise characters and drift characters in the paper were mentioned in detail. The key points during researching such as cancelling leakage current, making PCB with special materials, cleaning PCB, phase compensation and noise suppression method were also mentioned. At last, the calibration method for the system was explained step by step. The precision of our system in micro-current test was calculated according to the test results. The system's precision in micro-current measurement is about 1%. In the conclusion section, the work of dissertation is summarized and prospect of improving direction of system is presented. Nowadays, the system has also been used in the calibration of PD (partial discharge) calibrator which is the most important device in PD test. As research continues, more and more application Fields with our system will be found.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis on transmission system in wind turbine with certain rotating velocities
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the complex structure of the transmission system in wind turbine, the current research is on dynamics simulation of the by using ADAMS and continues analysis of bifurcation and chaos of the responses are carried out for better understanding relationship between the dynamic behavior and its status. The results showed that the dynamic model is reliable to learn the periodicity of the system caused by the gear meshing, bearing stiffness and other factors. These results could have certain guiding significance for vibration characteristics, fault symptom diagnostic parameters and fault diagnosis of the wind turbine transmission system.

articleTitle: Research on differential sampling method with 10 Volt programmable josephson voltage standard at NIM
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper describes a differential sampling method which uses a commercial sampling Analog Digital Converter (ADC) and the Programmable Josephson Voltage Standard (PJVS) to measure the ac voltages provided by the Fluke 5720A calibrator. Since this sampling technique discards the samples that contain the unpredictable transients between the quantized voltage steps within the stepwise approximate ac voltage generated by the PJVS, the error contributions of the transients to the measurement results can be greatly reduced. This is an important way for the dissemination of the ac voltage generated by the PJVS system. The experimental results show that, after averaging, the measurement uncertainty of a ac voltage with the amplitude of 0.707 Vrms at 60 Hz is less than 1 µV (type A).

articleTitle: The measurement system of Faraday effect in an optical fiber based on Stokes parameter analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Magneto-optical fiber plays an important role in magneto-optical devices. The Faraday effect has broad applications such as Faraday rotators, isolators and current sensors. This paper investigates the magneto-optical properties by measuring the polarization states in the fiber. A new magneto-optic system based on the Stokes parameters method is designed, which could analyze the Faraday effect in an intuitive way. The evolution of polarization states in an optical fiber is described by a series of Jones matrices and Stokes parameters. The relationship between the Jones matrix and Stokes parameters of a same polarization state is given. The corresponding Faraday rotation angle can be measured in the external magnetic field with different magnetic strength by using this measurement system. The magnetic field is generated in a customized solenoid driven by a current source. The optical fiber under test is put into a glass tube in the center of the solenoid. The light beam is coupled into the fiber by a positioning stage with lens and transferred all in free space in order to decrease the influence of intrinsic birefringence in the fiber. The output beam is received by the external receiver of the polarization analyzing system which extracts the Stokes parameters of the polarized light. The Faraday rotation angle equals the difference of two azimuths drawn from the Stokes parameters of the input and output polarizations. The final output polarization state described by Stokes parameters can also be viewed directly in the Poincare sphere. The Verdet constant of a commercial SMF is measured to be -2.36±0.01 rad/(T·m) at 660nm and -0.53±0.01 rad/(T·m) at 1550nm, respectively, which validate the good performance of this measurement system.

articleTitle: Application of curvature driven diffusion model in lateral multi-lens video logging image inpainting
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to restore the image's defect which results from the lateral multi-lens video logging device. This paper proposes an image inpainting model algorithm based on curvature driven diffusion model which uses the thermal diffusion principle in Physics, diffusing the surrounding information to the region which needs to be repaired. Firstly, introduce the curvature factor to the diffusion coefficient of TV inpainting model. Secondly, discretize the divergence function. And according to the surrounding pixel information, calculate the defect pixel information which needs to be restored. Finally, fill the calculation results into the defect region of image to complete image defect restoring process. The experimental results show that the algorithm improves the connectivity deficiency of TV model, making the result image looks natural and satisfies the precision accuracy of image logging.

articleTitle: A design of differential capacitance detection circuit
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The application of distance differential capacitance sensors to measure micro vibrations is now widely witnessed in the field of earthquake engineering. However, the structure of detection circuits is correspondingly complex for the vibration signal is small. This design improved the situation by updating the switch device structure in switching phase-sensitive detection circuit. It is demonstrated by experiments that the new circuit has a wide measure range when the displacement of sensor is less than 0.295mm, the linearity is less than 1.2% and the sensitivity is about 9.524V / mm.

articleTitle: Metal structure damage location pattern matching method based on virtual damage characteristics
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To solve the problem of pattern matching method damage completeness which was difficult to achieve in practice, the concept of virtual damage characteristics (VDC) was presented through abstracting and refining metal structure common damage characteristics. VDC in different locations were designed and then analyzed to obtain the strain fields and build the characteristic vectors which reflected the location information, and further the structure state pattern database was built. The calculation methods of the characteristic vectors similarity and matching degree were defined. The actual damage characteristic vector was put into the pattern database to search and match. The matching results were given according to matching degree from high to low. Finally, the test verification was done and showed the proposed method in the paper can be carried out to determine the structure damage location.

articleTitle: Investigation of the polynomial models in the definition of short and open calibration standards
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Measurement errors in network analysis can be separated into two categories: random and systematic errors. Both random and systematic errors are vector quantities. Random errors are non-repeatable measurement variations and are usually unpredictable. Systematic errors are repeatable measurement variations in the test setup. A measurement calibration is a process which mathematically derives the systematic error model for the VNA. Short and open standards are widely used in the calibration of network analyzers. And the definition precision of short and open standards has great influence on the measurement results of the VNA. Two types of calibration standard definitions-the calibration coefficient model and the data-based model are supported. In this paper, we focus on investigation of the coefficient models in the definition of short and open calibration standards. Based on coefficient model, they are usually simulated by a third order polynomial mode, which would introduce large fitting errors. By lots of definition experiments with different types of calibration kits, we do have found that the third order polynomial model yields less accuracy for the definition of short standards though it works well for the definition of open standards. Detailed research demonstrates that better fitting accuracy can be achieved by using higher order polynomial models. And also based on the analysis of the condition number with these models, proper polynomial model is recommended for the definition of short standards. Verification experiments have been conducted to assess the validity of the recommended polynomial model.

articleTitle: The research of microscopic vision and force sensing signal feedback hybrid position control on cochlear microelectrode testing system
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For cochlear microelectrode array the current way of testing is manual operation and it exist technical problems such as difficult to precision positioning, easy to damage electrode surface. The microelectrode automated testing system is developed with the visual image deflection and force feedback hybrid position control. The experimental results show that the use of image information to achieve the positioning error within 20 µm; using force feedback for the position fine-tuning of the probe detecting, keep testing force in 80–150 mN and the error is within 10 mN. Meet the requirement of testing for precise positioning and flexible contact.

articleTitle: The methodological approach to software key modules for 20GHz agile microwave signal generator
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on the agile signal generator, the paper places emphasis on two key modules of software, the user interface module and the baseband & data control module. Firstly, with the concept of object-oriented analysis in mind, we presents the realization of efficient and intuitionistic graph user interface, then introduces the basic concept, design requirements for baseband and data control. Then we focus on the data structure and algorithm of the control module. This software is now being used in agile signal generator and gain well replies.

articleTitle: Relative phase measurement of passive intermodulation products
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper studies relationship between phase shifts of carriers and passive intermodulation (PIM) products. Theoretical results have been obtained first through analytical derivation and Fourier transformation. And then a simple measurement method was proposed to conduct the relative phase shift test using easily available RF instruments. In this method, phase controllable RF signal sources were not required for test and only power levels are need to be measured. Microwave isolator with obvious nonlinear property was used as device under test. It's demonstrated that the relative phase shift of carriers lead to phase shift of PIM products. 3rd order PIM product behaviors as the theory predicts while 5th order PIM product shows different tendency with prediction to some degree.

articleTitle: Design and realization on digital gauss forming algorithm of gamma-ray pulse based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Nuclear spectrum is the important information in domain of nuclear physics research. Radiation detection and applications of nuclear technology, nuclear spectrum measurement technique have been a hot issue. And one of the key technologies of digital nuclear spectrum measurement technology is how to achieve digital filter-shaping algorithm on the digital processing device. Base on Sallen-Key filter model and Kirchhoff Current Law, the digital Gauss shaping algorithm of digital gamma spectrum measurement is deduced and analyzed in this article, and simulated the nuclear pulse by use of Matlab7.0. In order to apply the algorithm in FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) chip, this article improves and optimizes with SD coding method. And the experiments verify the correctness and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: The restriction modal analysis of infantry combat vehicle auto-gun
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The restriction modal of infantry combat vehicle auto-gun is analyzed applying the finite element analysis software ANSYS aiming at the modal analysis of a certain infantry combat vehicle auto-gun under the situation of complicated restriction. According to the structure specialty of infantry combat vehicle auto-gun, the tube of the three-dimensional model is set up by Pro/E software, the auto-gun is mesh generated by ANSYS/Workbench alone and the freedom modal is analyzed and then the restrictions are added and the restriction modal is analyzed. The complexity of the first mode and the MAC of the first six modes are done for the restriction modal of infantry combat vehicle auto-gun, according to the analysis results, we can find out that the restriction modal is correct for infantry combat vehicle auto-gun, wich has shown the importance of the complicated restriction for modal analysis.

articleTitle: The research of osmotic pressure instrument with high accuracy based on cryoscopy theory
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Osmotic pressure gauge is widely used in the field of medicine and health. At present, the most commonly used osmotic pressure gauge have disadvantages of complex structure, high cost, low test efficiency and precision. For this reason, we propose a novel osmotic pressure test instrument in the paper, which is designed by cryoscopy theory. Meanwhile, the principle, the implementation scheme and functional characteristics of the system are introduced in the paper. The instrument has the advantages of small volume, high precision, fast detection speed etc.. In addition, the apparatus is designed with a data transmission interface, which is convenient for data analysis and comprehensive utilization.

articleTitle: Fieldbus: Developing a laboratory prototype for learning purposes
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a distributed control and measurement system based on the Foundation Field Bus protocol. A system's prototype is described together with some implementation details and experimental results. The system also includes interfaces for conventional measurement and control devices that are connected through 4-20 mA current loops. The proposed prototype seems to be a very suitable solution for teaching purposes since it is an open solution that can be used to integrate devices from different manufacturers, as long as the prototype is provided with the appropriate interface.

articleTitle: Design of the environmental temperature and humidity wireless monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Conditions of the environmental temperature and humidity have important impacts on quality of people's life and productivity of agriculture. This system mainly combining novel wireless communication technologies and software, uses wireless transceiver nRF24L01, USB communication and Labview software to combine microcontroller SPCE061A, digital temperature sensor DS18B20 and capacitive relative humidity sensor HS1101 as a whole wireless environmental temperature and humidity monitoring system, which can accurately and visually show changes in environmental temperature and humidity conveniently.

articleTitle: A polyphase digital down converter method for GHz high speed sampling signal
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For the limitation of the processing speed in hardware, the traditional down-conversion doesn't work for GHz high speed sampling signal. In this paper, a novel approach is proposed with polyphase decomposition to achieve the down-conversion of the GHz high speed sampling signal. In this method, the input high speed sampling signal and the corresponding oscillation signal are parallelized to be M sub-channels of low speed sampling with delay and decomposition approach, which can be viewed as polyphase decomposition. The down-conversion operation is performed for each channel of input data. Then the down-conversion of the GHz high speed sampling signal is derived with the down-conversion results of each channel. The simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On-chip temperature-control and simulation of dual-mass micro-gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents the structure design, working principles and heat transformation of the on-chip temperature-control for dual-mass micro-gyroscope. The dedicated temperature sensor and heater provide real-time monitored and controlled working environment for the micro-gyroscope, thermal stabilization is thus achieved by maintaining the gyroscope temperature larger than the highest temperature of the surroundings. Moreover, thin glass membrane is formed and hermetic vacuum encapsulation is implemented help improve the heat insulation and reduce the power consumption. Finally, FEM analyses are performed and results from the simulations validate the practicability of the on-chip temperature-control system.

articleTitle: Study on the frequency forecast method of hydrogen maser based on EMD
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The standard time/frequency signal from the time keeping laboratories is produced and maintained mainly by commercial hydrogen masers and cesium clocks. The former has excellent short-term stability and good low noise characteristics, but with frequency drift significantly, their long-term stability will be decreased with time gradually. So using a hydrogen maser as the UTC (k) frequency source, it is essential to predict the frequency and its drift of the hydrogen maser accurately. In this paper, a method, which forecasts frequency with empirical mode decomposition extracting frequency change trend of the hydrogen maser, is presented. And the forecasting frequency, as an amount of adjustment, is used to steer the signal from the master clock frequency source. The result shows that the frequency predicting method is simple and effective, to not only improves the frequency accuracy of UTC(k), but also retains good short-term stability properties of signals.

articleTitle: Research and development of intelligent diagnosis based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The intelligent diagnosis technology has got a rapid development in the past few decades. Some new theories and methods have been applied to practice successfully, and obtained fruitful achievements. The artificial neural network leads to a new way for the research on fault diagnosis. It also provides a new scientific theory and thinking way for fault diagnosis. The intelligent fault diagnosis technology based on neural network has a great application potential and practical value. At present, it plays an irreplaceable role in monitoring, prediction, diagnosis and control of mechanical equipment condition, especially in the study of nonlinear and non-stationary signal processing. It shows that the intelligent fault diagnosis technology based on neural network is worthy of serious study. However, each diagnosis method has both advantages and disadvantages. Because of the inherent mechanism of the artificial neural network, this method also has some weaknesses inevitably. It is difficult to find an almost perfect way for the fault diagnosis. Only the intersection of a variety of methods, theories and technologies, and the introduction of new technologies and thoughts, could get a more accurate result of the fault diagnosis. The fault diagnosis based on neural network mainly includes two processes, training and diagnosis matching. The research focuses on three aspects: considering the neural network as a classifier from the angle of pattern recognition, considering the neural network as a dynamic forecasting model from the point of fault prediction, and establishing an expert system based on the neural network from the perspective of knowledge processing. This paper introduces the two processes of fault diagnosis, analyzes the present research situation from the three different angles above, put forward their advantages and disadvantages respectively, and discusses the development trends in the future.

articleTitle: Integrated passive intermodulation verification unit for nonlinear device
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Schottky diode has been widely used in RF fields. Because of its nonlinear conductivity characteristic, it often works as a strong nonlinear device and achieves the goal of spectrum transformation, such as mixer, multiplier. Meanwhile, the intermodulation of Schottky diode can be very considerable due to its strong nonlinear conductivity characteristic. In this paper, a novel proposed passive intermodulation test unit based on micro-strip is designed to verify the intermodulation of a strong nonlinear device (Avago HSMS2820). This circuit unit integrates combiner, intermodulation detector, and works as a mini passive intermodulation (PIM) test sub-system. The reverse and forward intermodulation of the diode in this unit has been tested simultaneously and the measured 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> PIM level has a good agreement with the harmonic balance (HB) simulation, which proves that the unit is feasible for the verification of intermodulation distortion. In the future, this unit can be used to test other devices with different nonlinear conductivity and give a revelation for the research of the mechanism of PIM generation in frequency domain.

articleTitle: Research on co-simulation system of omni intelligent mobile equipment
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel method of co-simulation is proposed to raise the exploration efficiency of driver and control circuit (D&CC) which is the electric part of Omni intelligent mobile equipment (OIME) with four freedoms. A three-dimension model of it is established for kinematic and dynamic simulation by using the dynamic simulation software Adams and consequently, the software interface with inputs and outputs is configured and exported from Adams, which is used to achieve the communication between MATLAB/Simulink software and Adams software. The control model of co-simulation system is set up through a variety of Simulink blocks, which is able to collect and handle the four different signals from D&CC and output to the interface. Consequently, the model of OIME in Adams is controlled by D&CC timely and directly via control model and software interface. Meanwhile, the whole simulation process is cooperatively controlled through Graphical User Interface (GUI) of MATLAB software and wireless remote-controller determining the four outputs of D&CC. The simulation results indicate that the co-simulation system of OIME has preferable and awesome animation effects, and the accuracy of D&CC is also validated simultaneously.

articleTitle: Tracking based on the adaptation of double gains and feedforward initiation for burst DSSS signals
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To promise code tracking precision of burst DSSS signals, an improved adaptive algorithm was proposed on the minimum mean-square error (MMSE) criterion to adjust double gains of code tracking loop. During each epoch, Gains of discriminator and NCO (numerical controlled oscillator) were all optimized, which avoid the problems of existing single gain adaptive algorithms, such as imprecision and instability. Meanwhile, focusing on the problem of carrier tracking, the feedforwad frequency estimation based on the first epoch was adopted to initiate FLL (frequency locked loop), which decrease the error of carrier tracking caused by the imprecision of the initial frequency value supplied by acquisition module. Compared with several existing algorithms, simulation results show the excellence of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of small target detection algorithm based on image gray entropy
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The local entropy algorithms (LEA) for aerial target have been introduced in the past, which were focused on its applications and improvements. In this paper, by the research and analysis about the features of the local entropy in detail and deeply, the relationships are studied quantitatively for the variations of the local entropy values for the single pixel target with the different contrast and the effects to this target from the different sizes of the neighbors. Also, the relationships between contrast, k, target size, m, and neighbor size, M, in local entropy, H(u,v), are analyzed. These analyses provide the quantitative analysis base for the aerial small target, such as infrared targets.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of modified planetary gear transmission based on real meshing stiffness
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The virtual prototype of modified planetary transmission was established by using the parametric modeling techniques in PTC Creo Parametric. The meshing stiffness is calculated according to the relative parameters and material property of the modified gears. The dynamic modal analysis was done in virtue of finite element model of the planetary gears in ANSYS, obtained the natural frequency and corresponding vibration mode, find the difference of natural frequencies between the normal and fault planetary gear of the transmission. It can be used in the mechanical design process to avoid the resonance phenomenon because of the theoretical natural frequency, and provided the reference and basis for the fault diagnosis of planetary gear system.

articleTitle: New method of designing 0.01GHz∼40GHz wideband directional detector
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a new method of designing ultra-wideband directional detector using monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMIC). The detector inherently is similar to a directional bridge, and so attains much broader band than ordinary directional coupler. The detector has good input port and output port match characteristics by way of computational formula according to the detector structure, almost 50 ohm at the input and output port. Simultaneously, the detector has low insertion loss and superior directivity, when signal travels in the reverse direction, the detection voltage got from the diode is zero approximately, which is what we desire in the ideal status. The diode employed is also an important device in the detector circuit. The diode is zero-bias diode specially fabricated, not the unbiased Schottky diode. It has wide dynamic range, high tangential sensitivity and high temperature stability. We executed detector circuit simulation in ADS, and got perfect performance. The detector circuit was fabricated in the MMIC in order to gain good uniformity and small area, and also low cost. Measured S-parameters show insertion loss is less than 2 dB, input and output return loss is less than -15 dB with frequency range from 10 MHz to 40 GHz. Still more, the wideband detector has superior directivity and sensitivity, with forward voltage variation 7mV/mW and reverse voltage variation less than 0.1mV/mW, which satisfies our demand.

articleTitle: Transonic air velocity estimation based on two-dimensional generalized MUSIC
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, the transonic measurement of air velocity is addressed based on an acoustic vector sensor. According to the measurement model of acoustic particle-velocity vector field developed by the analytical method of the equivalent acoustic source, we establish the relationship between the observation data of the acoustic vector sensor and the transonic air velocity to be estimated. A two-dimensional Generalized Multiple Signal Classification algorithm for Air Velocity Estimation (GMUSIC-AVE) is proposed. The GMUSIC-AVE algorithm can not only make the correct judgment between the subsonic and supersonic air velocity, but also yield high estimation accuracy of the current air velocity. Simulations are implemented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Investigation and design of disciplined clock system based on BDS
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This research focused on a design of disciplined clock based on BDS(BeiDou navigation satellite system). Measurement and analysis were performed for BDS timing signal based on the measurement of 1pps signal time offset between crystal oscillator and BDS timing receiver, using time interval counter with resolution as high as 250ps. According to the characteristics that the timing signal has a large jitter, but it has no bias over a long haul, a combination of least square fitting method and Kalman algorithm was applied to analyze time interval data, to depress the error of measurement noise, and estimate highly accurate time interval data. The results of the system's measurement showed that frequency stability at 1000s was reduced to 1×10–13 from 1×10–11 after disciplining the crystal oscillator.

articleTitle: cMass - a component-based development framework for mass spectrometry application
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a component-based framework cMass which supports rapid development of mass spectrometry application. By decomposing systems into relatively independent, mature and reusable modules, component-based programming provides stability, reliability and extensibility compared to other programming methods. The framework covers kernel components for mass spectrometry application, which are spectrum visualization component, signal processing component, instrument control component and workflow management component. cMass is implemented by Microsoft .net framework with C# which is perfectly matched with component-based programming. A practical project is carried on to validate the framework and result shows its availability.

articleTitle: Research on calibration for automatic test system based on scattering parameters of cascaded microwave networks
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the practical application of microwave automatic test system, due to the complexity of test channels and unconventional requirements, the system in general in the automatic test method of On Station Calibration makes that system configuration of the general instruments and equipment cannot achieve effective correction of error test system by ideal calibration, thus resulting in a decline in the test accuracy of the system and even measure failure<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1–2]</sup>. To solve this problem, this paper presents a method calibration for automatic test system based on scattering parameters of cascaded microwave networks, It can ensure test accuracy without distortion in different test conditions, satisfy the high performance, high accuracy, multi-parameter, multi-function automatic test requirements in the form of generalization.

articleTitle: Application of computer aided analysis in the structural design of microwave components
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the development of technology, microwave components have been used in various fields widely. The performance and the reliability of the components must be improved to fulfill the requirements of the complex environment. It is a big problem for the structural designers to predict various results during the design process. In this paper, several factors, which are electromagnetic field, heat exchange, vibration and force, are discussed. They have important influence on the performance and the reliability of the microwave components. And with the aid of professional software, the designer analyzes several cases. Some problems are found and some optimizations are also taken to improve the structure projects. The results are satisfactory. These methods are applicable to all microwave components.

articleTitle: Mechanical fault diagnosis method based on Mahalanobis Distance and LMD
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Against non-stationary characteristics of the mechanical fault vibration signal, this paper proposed a diagnosis based on LMD (Local Mean Decomposition, LMD) and Sensitive Threshold. This author adopted LMD to process the vibration signal and obtained a set of PF (Production Function, PF), adopted K-L (kullback-leibler) divergence to extract principal PF components, calculated their time-domain parameter indexes, combined them into a feature vector. Based on Mahalanobis Distance, this author took Mahalanobis Distance sensitive thresholds to represent different fault states, took the mean of multiple normal signal feature vectors as the standard feature vector, calculated the Mahalanobis Distance sensitive threshold of the unknown feature vector and the standard feature vector, and finally identified the fault states. The results showed that this method can effectively identify the mechanical fault, better than EMD (Empirical Mode Decomposition, EMD).

articleTitle: Research on some key technologies of 9 KHz – 3 GHz digital vector network analyzer
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The software and digital is the development trend of vector network analysis. Combined with the idea of software radio, this paper presented a design scheme of vector network analyzer and discussed the key technologies and implementation. Firstly this paper studied the principle and composition of vector network analyzer, the overall design of the system hardware was given. Secondly, we discussed the related theories of the design and key technology. The research contents include: The technology of real-time wideband spectrum analysis, Real time dynamic range expanding technology, Wideband digital downconversion Technology, and Variable rate signal processing. The system structure and working process of the key system function had detailedly designed. Through the numerical simulation and experimental verification, we proved the correctness and feasibility of the design scheme.

articleTitle: Performance reliability evaluation of the feature vector in one-dimensional components based on the grey system theory
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the selection and evaluation of low strain stress wave signal feature for one-dimensional components damage detection, define the quantitative information entropy based on probability theory and mathematical statistical theory and information entropy, build the feature vector of stress wave signal with the quantitative information entropy based on the time-window, by using the multi-parameter correlation analysis method of the grey system theory, raise the evaluation model of feature vector. This method is tested using stress wave of pile detection, the experimental results show that the feature vector of the quantitative information entropy has advantages in synthetic performance. The evaluation method raised in this paper can be widely applied to detect damage and defects of one-dimensional components like pile foundations, beam structures and mechanical rotators.

articleTitle: A calculation method of three-dimension temperature field of an air condition room
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With increasing energy demand, energy conservation has become a focus of attention, of which air condition accounts for a large proportion. To refrain from dissipation, the room temperature should be constantly measured to a crumb. However, the accurate room temperature is shown as three-dimension temperature field, which cannot be optionally described by any point of the room. Three-dimension air heat equation is accepted in this paper, which is helpful for us to calculate and design air condition system because the energy change of a room is reflected by numerical solve. With the traditional simulation and measurement approaches, accurate and comprehensive analysis is too difficult to conduct, which often produces errors or fails to acquire the numeric solution. In this paper, a particular method is provided to soft measure the air-conditioning temperature field by calculating the three dimension heat transfer equation.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant attitude control of spacecraft by using robust adaptive method
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, an attitude control scheme based on MRPs (The Modified Rodrigues Parameters) for a spacecraft subject to external disturbances and partial loss of three-axis effectiveness is proposed. First of all, the author establishes the dynamic model of spacecraft and the attitude kinematic equation based on MRPs, and the faults of the angular momentum exchange devices are modeled as multiplicative unknown dynamics. Then, the desired angular velocity of a spacecraft is derived from the relationship between the desired attitude and the real-time attitude of a spacecraft. Next, an observer is designed to estimate the fault factor of the spacecraft. By using the estimated fault factor, a robust controller based on indirect adaptive method is designed to achieve the attitude maneuver control. Therefore, this method can handle the faults of actuators without using the fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) mechanism. Simulation results are provided to verify the performance of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Gamma spectra resolving based on differential function analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Generally, people use Monte Carlo and Geant4 methods to simulate the interactions of gamma photons with the detectors (NaI(Tl), Ge(Li), HPGe and so on), to calculate the response function of detecting system. But when they make separate lines of the measured spectra, energy peaks are hard to simulate for noise signals. In order to including noise signals from the statistical fluctuation of the detector, we designed some special differential functions to measure the gamma energy change for scattering effects, and to better record the accumulated counts in a constant energy region. We interpolated the ideal spectra with the use of designed differential functions. We presented some simulation results, which show that differential functions are effective even in energy spectra with low counts.

articleTitle: Multi-modal signal propagation model based on time reversal method
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the defect non-destructive testing problem for one-dimensional rod-like structure, a time reversal based defect signal multi-modal propagation model is developed and a new one-dimensional structure non-destructive testing method based on time-reversal and multi-modal is proposed. Through analyzing the dispersion effect of guide waves in steel leading to signal distortion which means a single mode waveguide is changed to multi-modal, a multi-modal transfer function of the structure is formatted which theoretically verifies the feasibility of time reversal for one-dimensional structure defect testing. The simulation results show that time reversal method can be applied well in one-dimension structure to eliminate the multi-modal of guided wave and emphasis defect signal.

articleTitle: Novel micro fluidized bed pyrolysis reaction analyzer
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The micro fluidized bed pyrolysis reaction analyzer is an important platform. It is used for experimental analysis, kinetic analysis and the study of chemical reaction mechanism. In traditional mode, the sample is injected by hands, meanwhile the useful sample is single. It increased operative difficulty, which is not able to achieve the required accuracy for the dynamics experiment. In order to overcome this problem, this work redesigned the control system of analyzer's sample institution and fluidized bed. The experiment is used to access the performance of the proposed system, and the results shows that it improved the accuracy and automation degree of the instrument effectively compared with the traditional mode.

articleTitle: A method to diagnose the fault of phase array antenna element
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Phase array antenna is considered as one of the most promising antenna systems in the present. The diagnosis of it is an important issue in the field of phase array antenna. So this paper will study a method of diagnosing the fault of phase array antenna. This method is based on phase-shifted measurement and use Walsh function to generate a special step control matrix to reduce the times of measurement. Then solve the measurement function to get the excitation of antenna. Compare the result and prior information to find the fault element. This paper use Matlab to stimulate the method and the result indicate the method is right and workable.

articleTitle: FPGA-based underwater ultrasonic phased transmitting system using CMUTs
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to enhance the characteristics of underwater ultrasonic imaging system with small volume, low power supply voltage and easy integration, the underwater ultrasonic phased transmitting system is designed. Using field programmable gate array (FPGA) to control the excitation signals time-delay of 16 channels to achieve phased transmitting, and capacitive micro-machined ultrasonic transducer arrays (CMUTs) as the transmitting transducer. Then the operational amplifier and power amplifier circuit are designed and can be effectively improved the amplitude and power of the transmitting signals. The experimental results show that, the system can generate the excitation pulse signals with high frequency and high voltage, achieve phase time-delay precision to the minimum of 2.5ns, and echo signals of the imaging experiments are clearly. It provides a hardware foundation for the research of underwater ultrasonic imaging system.

articleTitle: An improved near-field measurement method and near-far field transformation for cylindrical conformal phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Near-field measurement has more advantages than conventional far-field measurement in determination of the antenna characteristics. An improved near-field measurement method and near-far field transformation for radar cylindrical conformal array antenna is presented in this paper, in order to meet the requirements, such as wide near field scanning range, high precision of near-far field transformation, fast testing efficiency and so on. Near-filed data including amplitude and phase is measured automatically by a cylindrical scan measurement system. Considering shielding effect of cylinder, near-far field transformation which is the most important part of near-field measurement has been proposed and based on Kirchhoff integral. Calculating far-field pattern utilizes near-field data in both polarizations, vertical and horizontal, and 3D far-field pattern of radar cylindrical conformal phased array antenna is obtained finally, the characteristics of antenna are displayed and analyzed conveniently. It is shown that this method is faster and more efficient than traditional method.

articleTitle: Development of self-sustaining circular sheet piezoelectric generator and measurement research
publicationTitle: 2015 12th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To solve generator problem of the sensor nodes for floating bridge monitoring system, design a kind of self-sustaining circular sheet piezoelectric generator. Its most important feature is the use of a self-sustaining circular sheet piezoelectric structure, it converts the mechanical energy into vibration excitation source, so as to extend the load's continuous effect and correspondingly extend the generator time; Describe its operating principles, the output electricity energy increases when piezoelectric circular sheet becomes resonance. In order to test and analyze the electrical generation performance of self-sustaining piezoelectric generator, built the measuring platform based on vibration exciter to simulate vibration test, in the design of this measuring platform, displacement sensor is used to measure the amplitude of piezoelectric circular sheet, charge amplifier is used to measure the electricity quantity generated by piezoelectric circular sheet, and the test result shows that increase the exciter load and work under the natural working frequency of piezoelectric circular sheet will increase the generating capacity of self-sustaining circular sheet piezoelectric generator.
